The project is in `./app` (groupId `org.acme`, artifactId `order-tools`) and `mvn -B -ntp -DskipTests test-compile` passes. I didn't run the app, call a model or run the tests; I only compiled them.

The project uses Quarkus 3.40.1 with `rest-jackson`, `langchain4j-ollama` and `mcp-server-http`. Ollama is the model provider, set to `llama3.2` in `application.properties`.

- **Order data:** `OrderService` keeps five sample orders in a map. It can look up an order by id and list a customer's most recent orders, newest first.
- **MCP tools:** `OrderMcpTools` exposes `getOrderStatus` and `listRecentOrders`. The `mcp-server-http` extension serves them over HTTP. I didn't set the transport path, so the endpoint is the extension's default, which I took to be `/mcp` and didn't verify.
- **Assistant:** `POST /assistant` takes `{"question": "..."}` and returns `{"answer": "..."}`. `Assistant` is an AI service that calls the same two operations through `OrderAiTools`.
- **Tests:** `OrderServiceTest` covers the lookup and ordering logic only. Nothing exercises the MCP endpoint or `/assistant`.

The Quarkus tool set up by `quarkus_create` started a dev-mode instance, which I stopped. It also generated `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and Dockerfiles. I didn't edit the README, so it still holds the generated content.
